p3.text: Last month my family moved to a new __(1)__ in a quiet street. It has three bedrooms, a big __(2)__ with a round table and a nice garden. My favourite room is the __(3)__ room because there is a big window and a soft sofa. I give a bedroom with my little __(4)__, but we have fun together. On the walls we put some __(5)__ of our old home. The friends are very friendly and the little dog next door always says hello.

p4.title: Grandparents’ houses
p4.text: Many grandparents live in houses that are different __(1)__ ours. Often, their houses have a lot __(2)__ photos on the walls and interesting things in every room. My grandma’s kitchen is __(3)__ but always warm, and there is a nice __(4)__ of cakes. Some grandparents live in a small house with a garden __(5)__ they can grow vegetables. Others live in a flat in town and go to the park __(6)__ day. Children __(7)__ visiting their grandparents because they __(8)__ funny stories __(9)__ the past. When I visit my grandparents, I always want to __(10)__ for dinner.

parts.text: Every Saturday morning, my family wakes up early. Mum starts making pancakes and Dad makes tea for everyone. My baby brother Jamie usually wakes up first, at about 7:30. After breakfast, we all help to clean the house. I always tidy the living room and my sister Ellie cleans our bedroom. Mum does the washing and Dad cleans the bathroom. At 11 o’clock, we stop and have some fruit juice. Last Saturday, Jamie made everything dirty in the kitchen with his cereal! Mum wasn’t angry, she just laughed. After lunch, we went to the park with our dog, Rocky. Rocky ran for two hours and then slept for all the day. In the evening, we all watched a film together with some biscuits. It was the best day of my week.

p6.title: My cousin’s flat
p6.text: My cousin Oscar lives in a beautiful flat in the city. The flat __(0)__ on the fifth floor and it has a lovely balcony. From __(1)__ balcony, you can see all the city. Oscar’s bedroom is __(2)__ big as mine. He has a little white dog called Milo who always sleeps __(3)__ the sofa. On weekends, I sometimes go to visit Oscar __(4)__ we play video games. His mum, my aunt, is very kind and makes __(5)__ the best biscuits in the world. When it is late, my dad comes to pick me up in the car.
